column1: # Track B's bases on `trackb-merged`, in merge order, from the last known-good point on. The runner replays a seed with a
# week under 90% on time on the last known-good point and on each base after it; the first base that fails names the part
# to drop. A `trackb-merge-<n>` tag marks a known-good point (40 window weeks in a row at 90% or more), placed on the
# runner's word; merge 1 (`trackb-merge-1.x`) failed its thin exam and is no such point. `fingerprint` is the variant's at `commit`; `pairs.py` changed at row 3, so from there on
# the pair variants have new fingerprints with the same decisions (the base 1f5cc2d99373 -> a273491eedbd).
# `state`: known-good, window (on `trackb-merged` and in the rolling window), ready (built, not yet on `trackb-merged`), or
# out (dropped from the stack by the played rows), or part (a step inside the head, not played alone). Since 22:19 UTC the
# aggressive line is folded into `trackb-merged`: all 8 worlds play its head, and `trackb-aggressive` is retired.
# `kind`: value (changes only a number of something already played live; needs the tag only) or code (a code
# change under spreadlab beyond variants.py, or a feature never played live; also needs the live desk's crash replay,
# and the live desk has the last word).
# each aggressive row is the newest safe row plus the aggressive parts, and is judged paired with the safe window.
# The note cache (6f24267) changed pairs.py, whose hash is `pair_version`, and notes.py, so every fingerprint moved with the
# same decisions; rows at 3a239ec7 or later carry the new ones, and the `trackb-merge-<n>.1` retags are the old tags' bases
# on that code, proved by the runner's to-the-cent replays. The default is b03c174e94be there (80a4235be07c before).
# b3f2bae2 (row 8's kind_fees) and 45ac6283 (the climb's second driver level, rich_drivers / when_rich) are code rows that
# moved every fingerprint with the same decisions, proved by the runner's to-the-cent replays: row 7 b2d6c0062dab ->
# Rollbacks move the played row, not this branch: `trackb-merged` only moves forward, so this file only grows here.
# `role`: base (the row the stack is rebuilt on and rolled back to) or record (a tag that is not a round candidate).
